ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: a pilgrimage
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: walk a pilgrimage for my god
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.deed: walked a pilgrimage for their god

plain.li: I've vowed it: a pilgrimage on foot to my god's holy place, and an hour's prayer there.
I owe my god a walk, and I mean to pay it.
[spark:loss] I can't stay in this house with all of them looking at me. I'm going to walk, and pray where it's quiet.
[spark:downed] I was nearly gone. Someone kept me here, and I'll walk to thank them.

warm.li: I want to go and say thank you somewhere that matters, on my own two feet.

blunt.li: Vowed a pilgrimage. I'll go when the work lets me.

cheerful.li: A long walk and a god at the end of it. I can't think of a better day.

gloomy.li: Maybe if I walk far enough I'll find out whether anyone is listening.

cold.li: I made a vow. I will keep it.

plain.li: I walked it. My feet ache, and I've never felt so light.
I prayed where my god is closest, and I came home a little different.

warm.li: I said thank you where it could be heard. I think it was.

blunt.li: Went. Prayed. Came back. Vow kept.

cheerful.li: I made it there and back, and the god was in a good mood, I'm sure of it.

gloomy.li: Nobody answered out there either, but the walk did me good.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: a temple
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: see a temple raised to my god
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.deed: saw a temple raised to their god

plain.li: I've vowed my god a temple: a room of its own, fine enough that nobody could mistake it.
Our gods live in corners. I've sworn to change that for mine.
[spark:battle] We lived through that. Somebody up there deserves a proper house for it, and I've sworn to see it built.
[lowtech] I've sworn my god a house with a roof and good things on the walls.

warm.li: I want my god to have a room as good as ours. Better, even.

blunt.li: I swore a temple. We're building one.

cheerful.li: A temple! With carvings! I've sworn it, so now we have to.

gloomy.li: If the gods won't come to us in a hovel, maybe they'll come to a temple.

cold.li: A god served in a corner is served badly. I have vowed a temple.

plain.li: The temple stands. I go in every evening just to look at it.
My god has a house now, and I kept my word.

warm.li: It's beautiful in there. Everyone helped, and I'll never forget it.

cheerful.li: Have you seen the temple? Go and see the temple.

cold.li: The temple is finished to the standard I swore.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: a lamp kept lit
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: keep a lamp lit at my god's place for a season
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.deed: kept a lamp lit at their god's place for a season

plain.li: I've vowed it: the lamp at my god's place stays lit from now till the season turns, and I'll be the one to see to it.
A light at the shrine, every night of the season. I'll carry the fuel myself.
[spark:loss] It went so dark when they died. I'll keep one light burning, at least, and keep it where it counts.
[lowtech] I've sworn to keep the torch at the holy place burning a whole season, and to feed it with my own hands.

warm.li: Somebody should keep a light there for the ones who come at night. Let it be me.

blunt.li: Vowed a lamp. It stays lit. I check it every day.

cheerful.li: A whole season of a little light at the shrine. I like that it'll be mine.

gloomy.li: If the dark comes, it'll find the one lamp I kept. That's something.

cold.li: I have vowed a lamp kept lit for a season. It will be kept.

plain.li: The season's out and the lamp never went dark once. I kept it.
Every night of the season it burned. I'll miss going to see to it.

warm.li: I kept the light for everyone. I hope somebody felt it.

cold.li: The light was kept to the last night of the season.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: a tree a week
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: plant a tree by hand every week for a season
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.deed: planted a tree every week for a season

plain.li: I've vowed a tree a week, every week of the season, set in the ground with my own hands. And I'll not lift an axe till it's done.
We take enough from the woods. I've sworn to give one back each week until the season turns.
[spark:birth] Something new came into the world. Let the trees grow up with it, one a week, by my hand.

warm.li: A tree a week. Somebody will sit under them one day, and that's enough for me.

blunt.li: Vowed a tree a week. No felling for me this season.

cheerful.li: Saplings! One every week! I'm going to have the best-kept little grove in the colony.

gloomy.li: I won't see most of them grown. I'll plant them anyway.

cold.li: I have vowed a tree each week for the season. I will plant them.

plain.li: The season's out, and every week there's a young tree standing where there wasn't one.
I kept it: a tree a week, and my axe never touched a trunk.

warm.li: Go and look at them. They're small yet, but they're ours.

cold.li: A tree each week, for the whole season, as I swore.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: plain bread
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: eat plain food only for a season
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.deed: ate plain food only for a season

plain.li: I've vowed plain bread for a season: simple meals and nothing finer, not even at a feast.
Nothing wasted, nothing grand. Plain food till the season's out, and I've sworn it.
[spark:loss] I don't want the good things just now. Plain bread will do me, and I've sworn to it.

warm.li: Leave the fine plates for the others. A plain bowl is all I want this season.

blunt.li: Plain food only. Vowed it. Don't offer me the fancy stuff.

cheerful.li: Simple meals for a whole season! It's going to make the first fine supper after taste incredible.

gloomy.li: It all tastes the same lately anyway. I may as well make a vow of it.

cold.li: I have vowed plain food for a season. Nothing finer will pass my lips.

plain.li: A whole season of plain bread, and I never broke it, not once.
The season's turned. I ate simply, as I swore, and I feel the better for it.

warm.li: It was easier than I thought, with all of you passing me the plain bowls.

blunt.li: Plain food, whole season. Vow kept.

cold.li: Plain food to the last day. It is kept.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: every caller fed
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: see every caller at the gate fed for a season
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.deed: fed every caller at the gate for a season

plain.li: I've vowed that no one comes to our gate this season and goes away unfed. I'll carry the bowls myself.
Whoever calls, trader or traveller, gets a meal from my hands. I swore it.
[lowtech] Every stranger at the gate shall have bread from me this season. That is my vow.

warm.li: Nobody should knock on our door and leave hungry. Not while I'm here.

blunt.li: Vowed to feed every caller. Keep the meals stocked.

cheerful.li: Feeding everyone who comes by! It's the best vow I ever made.

gloomy.li: I was hungry on the road once, and nobody fed me. I'll not be that kind of door.

cold.li: I have vowed that every caller this season is fed. It will be done.

plain.li: The season's out, and not one caller left our gate hungry.
Every one of them fed, from my own hands. I kept it.

warm.li: I liked seeing their faces when the bowl came out. I'll keep doing it, vow or no.

cold.li: No caller left unfed this season. It is kept.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: meals for a vow
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: Someone who has vowed no meat until a sick friend recovers wants vegetarian meals kept in the stores, so the vow can be kept.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: Keep at least {TARGET} vegetarian meals in storage or in the home area: the vegetarian simple, fine or lavish meal. Set a bill for them at the stove.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} has vowed no meat until someone sick is well, and there's nothing in the stores to keep the vow with.

plain.li: I've made a vow: no meat until they're well. Could the kitchen keep a few meals without it?
I swore off meat for a sick friend. I'd rather not starve keeping my word.
[lowtech] I've sworn no flesh until the fever breaks. A pot of something green would help me keep it.

warm.li: It's a small thing to give up for someone I love. I just need something else to eat.

blunt.li: No meat for me till they're better. Need meals without it.

cheerful.li: Vegetables for a while! My god likes a sacrifice, and I like a stew.

gloomy.li: If my vow is all I can do for them, at least let me keep it.

cold.li: I have vowed no meat. Vegetarian meals in the stores would let me keep it without fuss.

plain.li: There's food I can eat now, and a vow I can keep. Thank you.

warm.li: Thank you. Now I can keep my promise without going hungry.

plain.li: I'll keep the vow on bread and water, then.

gloomy.li: Nobody cares whether I keep my word. I'll keep it anyway.

li.label: meals for my vow
li.description: The kitchen has meals I can eat while I keep my vow. Someone took it seriously.
